posts.author: KindOtaku
posts.body:
Hi there!
I've been trying to create an Android actor who can upgrade their own body, kinda like how cyberware works in Cyberpunk 2077. You go to a ripperdoc and it opens a menu where you can buy and equip various upgrades. In a way very similar to a second separate Equip menu, but with upgrades instead of weapons and armor.
The problem I'm having is creating this separate menu. I've tried looking it up, but I've made little progress. I only want the player to be able to change their upgrades at the 'ripperdoc', though being able to see what upgrades one have equipped outside of it would also be nice.
Any help would be appreciated.
